evidence: The ALD precursors were tungsten hexafluoride (WF6, Aldrich, 99.9% +) and disilane (Si2H6, Scott Speciality Gases, electronic grade). The WF6 and Si2H6 precursors were alternately injected into the nitrogen carrier flow using computer-controlled pneumatic valves. The N2 flow rate was 200 sccm and the pressure in the flow tube was 1.1 Torr.
